title: Protect remaining forest
summary: Keeps every wooded parcel on the map as forest, so no other policy can clear it for building while this one is in place.

how: Planning staff draft an amendment to the Land Use Management Ordinance that bars building on the protected woods.
The Planning Commission reviews the amendment and makes a recommendation.
Residents comment at a Town Council public hearing.
Town Council votes on the amendment.

pros: Keeps the woods' tree canopy and wildlife habitat.
Keeps forested land that soaks up stormwater.
cons: Blocks the homes other policies would build on these woods.
Owners of the protected land can no longer build on it.
New building has to go to land that is already developed, such as parking lots.
